title: descriptors/1: logP, MR, TPSA, H-bond counts, rotors, average weight and formula analysis of a drawing
description: The answer of `mzlab-cli mol measure`, the molkit `.wasm` `descriptors`, the app (`feat/grafo` kind `descriptors`) and mzDraw: one function, crates/mzlab-feat/src/chem/descriptors.rs. Numbers rounded to 4 decimals; theory for the drawn structure, nothing is fitted to data.

tpsa.description: topological polar surface area (Ertl 2000), N and O only, square angstrom

hbd.description: N and O atoms carrying at least one hydrogen

hba.description: hydrogen-bond acceptors (O, and N with a free lone pair)

mw.description: average molecular weight from conventional atomic weights (a drawn isotope counts with its mass number); null when an element has none

analysis.description: the analysis/1 document of the whole drawing (docs/schemi/analysis-1.json), the bytes of `mzlab-cli mol anal` for the same atoms
